invariants.name: agent_unique
invariants.statement: exactly one cell shows colour 6 at all times

invariants.name: block_count
invariants.statement: exactly 1 cell(s) show colour 2 at all times

invariants.name: blocks_disjoint
invariants.statement: no two blocks ever occupy the same cell

invariants.name: door_presence_tracks_net
invariants.statement: a door shows colour 5 exactly when its net's aggregate bit does not match its polarity, and shows nothing of its own otherwise

invariants.name: agent_conserved
invariants.statement: exactly one cell shows the agent at all times — a portal moves the agent, it never copies or deletes it

invariants.name: mouths_static
invariants.statement: each of the 2 portal mouth(s) shows colour 7 unless the agent is standing on it

claims.claimed: conditional — reversible on open floor, not across a one-way edge
conditional — only where the agent can reach the far side of the block

rules.name: walk
rules.reversible: conditional — reversible on open floor, not across a one-way edge
rules.then: the agent moves one cell in direction D
rules.when: act=D and the target cell is inside the grid, is not a wall, and no mechanism claims it

rules.name: blocked_by_wall
rules.when: act=D and the target cell is outside the grid or is a wall

rules.name: push
rules.reversible: conditional — only where the agent can reach the far side of the block
rules.then: the block moves one cell in direction D and the agent takes the block's old cell
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a block and the cell beyond it in direction D is free

rules.name: blocked_by_block
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a block and the cell beyond it is not free

rules.name: toggle_switch
rules.then: that switch's bit flips 0↔1 and the agent stays where it is
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a switch in toggle mode

rules.name: walk_through_door
rules.then: the agent enters the door's cell
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a door whose net's aggregate bit matches its polarity

rules.name: blocked_by_door
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a door whose net's aggregate bit does not match its polarity

rules.name: door_mirrors_net
rules.then: N is on iff any switch on N shows 1 (an OR network); the door is passable and undrawn iff N's aggregate bit matches P, and impassable and drawn otherwise
rules.when: at every instant, for a door on net N with polarity P

rules.name: teleport_twoway
rules.then: the agent is placed on the other mouth, independently of D
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds one mouth of a two-way pair and the other mouth is free

rules.name: blocked_portal_exit
rules.when: act=D and the target cell holds a portal whose landing cell is a wall, out of bounds, or occupied

spec.notes: Push, switch-door and a two-way portal in one grid. Three families is where the vocabulary a segmenter has to invent stops being obvious.
